[[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} '''Northern Vengeance''' is a [[Deep North]] [[Blood magic]] staff. On cast the Northern Vengeance launches [[Vengeance Sphere]] on the player and all allies in a 5-meters radius. The spell lasts 60 seconds per levels, cost 100 [[Eitr]] and 40% of the player current health. When a unit with '''Vengeance Sphere''' receive damage, it automatically launches back a projectile toward the attacker dealing a fixed amount of [[Frost]] damage. Contrary to the [[Staff of Protection]], The Northern Vengeance doesn't absorb or reduce the damage received. It cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding '''Cast: Northern Vengeance''' and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. ==Mould== '''Mould: Northern Vengeance''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. == Upgrade information == {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 ! [[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} '''Echo Spike''' is a [[Deep North]] [[Blood magic]] staff. The primary attack launches a projectile that deals no damage and passes through creatures. The projectile bounces when it hits terrain, a structure or another solid object, or automatically after 4 seconds. It then flies back in the direction it came from at the same speed. At the point of the bounce, the projectile deals 60 [[Fire]] damage and 60 [[Frost]] damage in an area that can also hit the player. After bouncing, the projectile passes through enemies. It damages each creature it touches only once. On each direct hit, it deals 50 Fire damage and 50 Frost damage, plus an additional 60 Fire damage and 60 Frost damage to enemies within a 2.42-meter radius. The projectile can bounce only once and stops when it hits terrain or a structure a second time. Depending on the terrain geometry, the returning projectile may stop immediately after bouncing. If it flies for four seconds without hitting anything, it disappears. The returning projectile does not damage the caster. If it passes through the caster, the caster regains 10 [[Eitr]]. Each cast of the primary attack costs 25 [[Eitr]]. This cost is reduced by up to 33% with the [[Blood magic (skill)|blood magic]] skill, to 16.75 at skill level 100. While wielded, the staff reduces movement speed by 5%. It cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding '''Cast: Echo Spike''' at a level 3 [[Galdr Table]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. Hardening takes 50 seconds and burns [[Liquid Frost]] as fuel at one unit every 10 seconds. ==Mould== '''Mould: Echo Spike''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. == Upgrade information == {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 ! [[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} |Creatures| {{InfoboxTabber |Bear| {{infobox creature | image 0star = Bear.png | image 1star = | image 2star = | trophy = | id = Bjorn_spiritcaller | location = | drops = | health 0star = 1500 | damage 0star = * Bite: 100 Pierce * Claws: 90 Slash, 40 Chop * Slam: 100 Blunt, 40 Chop, 40 Pickaxe * Swipe combo, right: 50 Slash, 40 Chop * Swipe left: 25 Slash, 40 Chop | health 1star = | damage 1star = | health 2star = | damage 2star = | abilities = * Bite (4 seconds) * Claws (4 seconds) * Slam (12 seconds) * Swipe combo, right (4 seconds each for 2 variants) * Swipe left (4 seconds) | weak = Fire | resistant = Pierce, Blunt, Frost | immune = Spirit |stagger=30% |faction=Players }} |Moose| {{infobox creature | image 0star = Moose.png | image 1star = | image 2star = | trophy = | id = Moose_spiritcaller | location = | drops = | health 0star = 1100 | damage 0star = * Hooves: 150 Blunt * Horns: 160 Slash * Sweep: 145 Slash | health 1star = | damage 1star = | health 2star = | damage 2star = | abilities = * Hooves (4 seconds) * Horns (4 seconds) * Sweep (4 seconds) | weak = Fire | resistant = Slash, Blunt, Frost | immune = Spirit |stagger=30% |faction=Players }} |Wolf| {{infobox creature | image 0star = Wolf.png | image 1star = | image 2star = | trophy = | id = Wolf_spiritcaller | location = | drops = | health 0star = 800 | damage 0star = 140 Slash | health 1star = | damage 1star = | health 2star = | damage 2star = | abilities = Attack (5s each for 3 variants) | immune = Spirit |stagger=50% |faction=Players }} |Boar| {{infobox creature | image 0star = Boar.png | image 1star = | image 2star = | trophy = | id = Boar_spiritcaller | location = | drops = | health 0star = 1000 | damage 0star = 100 Blunt | health 1star = | damage 1star = | health 2star = | damage 2star = | abilities = Attack (5s) | immune = Spirit |stagger=50% |faction=Players }} }} }} '''Spirit Caller''' is a [[Deep North]] [[Blood magic]] summoning staff. The Spirit Caller can summon Spirit versions of [[Bear]], [[Moose]], [[Wolf]] and [[Boar]]. These creatures have increased Health and damage compared to their wild counterparts. They have a transparent violet hue. The maximum number of summons for each creature type is equal to the Spirit Caller's level: one of each type at level 1, two of each at level 2, and so on. On each cast, the type of the next creature summoned is chosen randomly; if that type has already reached its maximum, the cast fails. As a result, it can take a large number of casts to reach the maximum for all four types. Summoned creatures follow the player who summoned them. A summon disappears if it is more than 150 meters from that player, or 120 seconds after that player has left the game. Each cast costs 100 [[Eitr]] and 40% [[Health]]. While wielded, the staff reduces movement speed by 5%. It cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding '''Cast: Spirit Caller''' at a level 3 [[Galdr Table]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]], which takes 50 seconds. It is upgraded at the [[Galdr Table]], from level 4 for quality 2 up to level 6 for quality 4. The [[Forge of Potential]] upgrade for this staff uses a [[Bloodgold Battle Idol]]. ==Mould== '''Mould: Spirit Caller''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. == Upgrade information == {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !
